tools.name: get_brand_assets
tools.description: List published brand assets available from the site.

tools.name: get_contact_options
tools.description: Read the published contact form path and field definitions in the requested language. Returns only the form path and fields.

language.description: Language for the published contact form field labels.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read published site content at an exact public catalog path, such as /learn/foo. Use the published path returned by the site catalog or search_site.

path.description: Exact public catalog path, for example /learn/foo.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Read a published learning video by its exact slug. Supply only the final segment of its /learn/ path: use foo for /learn/foo.

slug.description: Exact final slug of a published /learn/ video path, for example foo.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List published projects matching an optional search query. Returns all matching projects up to a maximum of 100.

query.description: Search text to match against published projects.

tools.name: list_videos
tools.description: List published learning videos, optionally filtered by category or search text. Returns up to 20 matching videos, with a default limit of 8.

category.description: Restrict published videos to this category.

query.description: Search text to match against published videos.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching videos to return.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search published site content by query, with optional content kind and category filters. Returns up to 20 matching results, with a default limit of 8.

query.description: Search text to match against published site content.

kind.description: Restrict results to this kind of published content.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching results to return.
